I found Diana's body in medbay just now. My route was upper_engine → oxygen → cafeteria → medbay. I saw Eve in upper_engine at the start (ticks 2-4), she came in from oxygen. After that I didn't see anyone until I walked into medbay and found Diana dead. So I'd like to hear from everyone — especially where Alice, Bob, and Charlie were, since I have no info on them. Whoever was near medbay or storage (the connecting room) is my main suspect.

I can confirm part of Frank's story — I was in upper_engine when he came in from oxygen around tick 2-3, then he left toward oxygen at tick 4. My route was oxygen → upper_engine → medbay → electrical.

Important: when I passed through medbay at tick 7, both Bob and Diana were there alive. I continued on to electrical to do my task. So Diana was alive in medbay at tick 7 with Bob present. Frank says he found her dead in medbay later on his route (oxygen → cafeteria → medbay).

That makes Bob the last person I can confirm was with Diana. I'd really like to hear Bob's account — did he stay in medbay, who else came in? Charlie is also a complete unknown right now. My suspicion is leaning toward Bob unless he has a clean explanation.

My route was medbay → electrical → security → weapons. I started in medbay at tick 1 — I want to be upfront about that. I didn't see anyone there with me at the start, then I left for electrical at tick 2, where I saw Diana. After that I went to security, then to weapons where I was when the meeting got called.

So timeline-wise: I was in medbay early (tick 1), left before Eve says Bob and Diana were there together at tick 7. Diana was alive in electrical when I passed through around tick 2.

I can't confirm or deny Bob's story since I didn't see him at all. But Eve's account puts Bob as the last confirmed person with Diana in medbay, which lines up as the strongest lead. I'd really like to hear Bob explain his movements, and Charlie too since nobody has placed him anywhere yet. Leaning toward Bob right now, but want to hear them both before locking in a vote.

Yeah, Eve is right that she saw me and Diana in medbay around tick 7, but important detail: Diana was alive then. I didn’t stay there — my route was cafeteria → medbay → electrical, where I saw Diana earlier, then back through medbay, then I left up toward upper_engine after Eve passed through toward electrical.

So from my POV: Diana was alive in medbay when Eve came through, and I left shortly after. I did not see Frank until this meeting, and I never saw Charlie at all this round. If Frank found the body later, there’s a window after I left where someone could’ve come in from storage/electrical or cafeteria side.

I get why I’m being asked because I was last seen with her, but “last seen” isn’t the same as killer when Eve literally confirms she was alive at that moment. Charlie being completely unaccounted for is a big issue here, and I’d really like to hear his route before everyone tunnels me.

My route was storage → navigation → security. I started in storage at tick 1, then moved to navigation, then up to security where the meeting was called. I didn't see anyone the entire round — nobody passed through storage while I was there, and navigation and security were empty too.

I know "I saw nobody" is the weakest possible alibi, but it does mean I was on the opposite side of the map from medbay the whole time. Storage connects to medbay, yes, but I left storage early and went the other direction toward navigation/security, not toward medbay.

Now, analyzing what's been said: Eve confirms Frank's early movement, and Eve confirms Bob and Diana were alive together in medbay at tick 7. Eve then went to electrical — which Alice also says she passed through earlier. The key question is who entered medbay after Eve left.

Bob says he left medbay heading up toward upper_engine after Eve passed through. That's checkable in principle but nobody confirms it. Frank then arrives in medbay via cafeteria and finds Diana dead. So the killer entered medbay between tick 7 and when Frank arrived — and the most likely candidate is someone who was already there or came back.

Bob being the last confirmed person with Diana is genuinely the strongest lead. His defense ("Eve saw her alive") is technically true but doesn't account for what happened the moment Eve walked out. I'm leaning Bob. If I'm wrong, my next suspicion would be Frank himself for self-reporting, but Eve's timeline makes Bob more likely.

I'll vote Bob.

I already gave my initial report, so I'll keep this short and just respond to what's been said.

Eve's account lines up with mine — she was in upper_engine when I arrived, and our timelines match. That's a mutual alibi for the early game.

The key window is between tick 7 (Eve leaves medbay, Bob and Diana alive) and when I arrived in medbay via cafeteria. Bob claims he left toward upper_engine after Eve, but nobody saw him do that — and importantly, I was in cafeteria before medbay and didn't see Bob pass through there either. If Bob went up to upper_engine from medbay, he'd either go through cafeteria or directly. I didn't cross paths with him.

Alice's route (medbay → electrical → security → weapons) takes her away from the crime scene, and Charlie's storage → navigation → security puts him on the far side.

Bob is the last confirmed person with Diana, and his exit story isn't corroborated by anyone. I'm leaning Bob as well, but I want to hear if anyone can confirm seeing him in upper_engine or cafeteria after tick 7.

I already gave my account in my first speech, so I'll just respond to what's been said since.

Frank's point is important: he was in cafeteria before entering medbay, and he didn't see Bob pass through. If Bob really left medbay heading to upper_engine after I walked through, the natural path is either through cafeteria or back through upper_engine via medbay's connections. Frank was in cafeteria and didn't see him. That's a hole in Bob's story.

Also, Bob said in his speech "I left up toward upper_engine after Eve passed through toward electrical" — but medbay doesn't directly connect to upper_engine in a way that avoids being seen. He'd have to go through upper_engine's corridor, and Frank's earlier presence and route don't conflict with that, but nobody can corroborate it.

Charlie's storage → navigation → security route keeps him far from medbay the whole time. Alice's route takes her away early. Frank and I mutually alibi each other for the early game.

Bob is the last confirmed person alone with Diana, and his exit is uncorroborated while Frank's cafeteria pass-through contradicts the natural path Bob would've taken. I'm voting Bob.

Wait — I already spoke as speaker 3 earlier in this meeting. I gave my route (medbay → electrical → security → weapons) and said I was leaning Bob but wanted to hear him and Charlie out.

Now that I've heard everyone: Bob's story has a real hole. Frank was in cafeteria before going to medbay and didn't see Bob pass through — and if Bob left medbay heading up to upper_engine after Eve walked out, cafeteria is the natural path. That's uncorroborated and contradicts what Frank observed.

Eve and Frank mutually alibi each other for the early game. Charlie's route puts him on the far side of the map. My own route took me away from medbay by tick 2, and Diana was alive in electrical when I passed through.

Bob was the last person confirmed alone with Diana, and his exit doesn't hold up against Frank's cafeteria pass-through. I'm voting Bob.

I need to push back hard here because people are treating Frank “not seeing me in cafeteria” like it disproves my route, but it doesn’t. Medbay connects directly to upper_engine — I did **not** go through cafeteria. So Frank being in cafeteria and not seeing me there is not a contradiction at all.

My route was cafeteria → medbay → electrical → back through medbay → upper_engine. Eve came into medbay from upper_engine, saw me and Diana alive, then left toward electrical. After that I left out toward upper_engine. That’s the exact route I’ve been saying.

The people actually unconfirmed in the kill window are Frank and Charlie. Frank is the reporter and is the one who says he came in from cafeteria and found the body. Nobody saw Frank enter medbay and nobody can confirm he didn’t kill/report. Charlie also claims storage → navigation → security and “saw nobody,” but storage is literally connected to medbay, so saying he was “opposite side” is overstating it.

I get that I’m last confirmed near Diana, but the argument against me is based on a wrong map assumption. If you vote me off for “not being seen in cafeteria,” that’s just bad logic. I’m much more suspicious of Frank’s self-report here, or Charlie’s completely unverified route.

Bob makes a fair point about the map — medbay does connect directly to upper_engine, so Frank not seeing him in cafeteria isn't actually a contradiction. I want to acknowledge that because I don't want to railroad based on bad geometry.

That said, let me reassess. The kill window is after Eve leaves medbay (tick 7) heading to electrical. At that point Bob and Diana are alone together in medbay. Bob's claim is that he left to upper_engine right after. Nobody corroborates that, but nobody contradicts it either now that the cafeteria argument is off the table.

Who else could've entered medbay? Frank came in from cafeteria and found the body — self-report is possible but Eve alibis him for the early game and his path through cafeteria is consistent. Alice was already gone to electrical/security/weapons by then. I was on the far side at navigation/security. Eve went to electrical.

So realistically it's Bob or Frank. Bob was alone with the victim. Frank self-reported but has Eve's early alibi and no opportunity window I can see — he'd have had to be in medbay, not cafeteria, to kill.

Bob's correction is valid but doesn't erase the fact that he was the last person with Diana alive and his exit is uncorroborated. I'm still voting Bob, but with less confidence than before. If I'm wrong, Frank is next.

Voting Bob.
